name: Interpolating Fragment Attributes for Perspective Projection
aliases: Perspective-Correct Interpolation for Projected Tetrahedra (Front/Back Decomposition Variant)
definition: A technique to correctly interpolate barycentric coordinates and intersection length for perspective projection by leveraging linear interpolation of modified vertex attributes on the front side of a facet, avoiding discontinuities at facet boundaries.
summary: This method corrects perspective artifacts in volume rendering by interpolating modified back-side attributes on the front facet, enabling continuous rendering as a triangle fan for improved vertex-cache coherence.
